summary: Use the aws-terminator policies and the hacking/aws_config/setup_iam.yml playbook to create ansible-integration-ci and ansible-integration-unsupported groups, add a test user, and never test in a production account.
questions: How do I set up IAM for running AWS integration tests?
Is it safe to run AWS integration tests in my production account?

answer_card.title: AWS testing IAM policies
answer_card.answer_md:
Run `hacking/aws_config/setup_iam.yml` (policies from mattclay/aws-terminator) to create:
- `ansible-integration-ci`: for tests not marked unsupported (mirrors CI)
- `ansible-integration-unsupported`: extra rights, including IAM management

Create a user in these groups. Rights are minimized but still broad, so **never use a production account**.
